assumptions.execution: Signal at the close of the last session of each month; trades in the next session at its volume-weighted average price.
assumptions.universe: Point-in-time: the 500 most traded NSE stocks as known at each month-end, including companies later delisted. Funds and rights entitlements excluded.
assumptions.eligibility: A year of price history and at least Rs 10 crore traded a day (60-day median).
assumptions.costs: Zerodha delivery charges (STT, exchange, SEBI, stamp duty, GST, DP) plus 0.1% slippage a side.
assumptions.tax: Capital gains under current rules for every year: 20% short-term, 12.5% long-term above Rs 1.25 lakh, 4% cess, paid each April.
assumptions.dividends: Reinvested, untaxed. Index references are price-only: an index fund also earns roughly 1.2% a year in dividends.
assumptions.candidates: 37 strategies were tested. With that many, one will look good by chance: a t-statistic near 2 is weak evidence, and about 3 is the bar.
